limitations: This leaf does not claim runtime PASS; a full invocation records Docker, edge, I1 and I2 evidence for the root-owned runtime lease.
RetrospectiveOnly and ManualAcceptance skip the pre-existing SQL fixtures; RetrospectiveOnly runs the API-managed probe, while ManualAcceptance waits for root-owned API/UI acceptance.
ManualAcceptance serves only the owned disposable runtime and waits for a root-owned PASS/FAIL sentinel; the ready report omits credentials and tokens.
Optional edge development TLS inputs must be supplied together; only runtime copies under the owned keys directory are removed during cleanup.
BFF exposes actuator metrics but no Prometheus registry; I2 uses /actuator/metrics/http.server.requests with an exact URI tag.
The accepted Academic and Schedule SQL seeds are read-only references outside this scope.
